bottom_line: The ratings do not hold well tonight: Nasdaq-100 futures were down about 2% and S&P futures about 1% before the PCE inflation print, extending yesterday's 7.3% semis drop. The worldview's own risks (credit stress, hot inflation) are live, so wait for PCE and the first hour before acting on any Overweight.
what_changed: Futures fell early Wednesday: Nasdaq-100 -2.1% to -2.6%, S&P 500 -0.9% to -1.5% depending on the hour, on AI worries ahead of October PCE; Korea -6.2%, Nikkei -2.8%. Touches the 'AI trade crowded' thesis and the PCE risk.

Dell beat, raised its full-year forecast to $202bn with a $132bn AI backlog, and gross margin near 21% vs ~19.2% expected; shares moved only ~1-4% after hours. Supports the demand thesis, but the market keeps selling beats.
HPE -16% on lower Cloud & AI margins and ADI -17% despite a beat show guidance, not results, is driving prices.
US markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving, so tonight's session is followed by a holiday and a thin Friday.

trust: Only 12 ratings are graded so far; the 71 picks average -8.0% vs QQQ, and Buy/Overweight picks (-5.9%) beat the screen's no-AI #1 (-20.7%) and random picks (-9.1%) but trail QQQ itself.
if_buying: Wait for the PCE print and at least the first 30 minutes; futures are down about 1-2%.
Overweight means a small starter position; prefer the overweight segments (AAON, ETN, VST, PWR).
Skip DELL and MU tonight: their segments' outlook has weakened since they were rated.
Use limit orders; VIX above 30 and a holiday-thinned week make opening prints unreliable.
